title: Scheme and Galois Frobenius of the geometric fiber
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum
$p,a,q,k_0,k$ of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], where $q=p^a$, let $X_0$ be a
finite-type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]
$k_0$-scheme, and put $X=X_0\times_{k_0}k$. Let
$\sigma:k\to k$, $z\mapsto z^q$, be the arithmetic Frobenius and put
$\gamma=\sigma^{-1}=\operatorname{Frob}_q$, so that
$g_\gamma=\operatorname{id}_{X_0}\times\Spec(\gamma):X\to X$ is the
geometric-Frobenius automorphism of [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. The
$q$-power scheme Frobenius of $X_0$ is the $k_0$-morphism
$\Phi_0:X_0\to X_0$ of [def-weil-relative-frobenius-geometric-fiber], whose affine incarnation on an affine open $\operatorname{Spec}A_0\subseteq X_0$ is $a\mapsto a^q$; its
base change

$$
\Phi:=\Phi_0\times_{k_0}\operatorname{id}_k:X\longrightarrow X
$$

is a $k$-morphism with affine incarnation
$a\otimes b\mapsto a^q\otimes b$ on $A_0\otimes_{k_0}k$.
The finiteness [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and radiciality
[def-weil-radicial-morphism] of this constructed morphism are the
assertion of [lem-trf-scheme-frobenius-finite-radicial].
For $m\in\mathbf Z_{\geq0}$ write $\Phi^m$ for the $m$-fold
iterate, and write

$$
g_\sigma=\operatorname{id}_{X_0}\times\Spec(\sigma):X\longrightarrow X
$$

for the arithmetic Galois automorphism. On the
small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], the
derived pullback functors $L\Phi^m{}^*$ and $Lg_\gamma^{m*}$ are the
pullbacks along these endomorphisms, with the coefficient-stage conventions of
[def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].
